text:
evan: Quick heads-up — ran a lightweight onboarding bench for sparrow-6b on the canary cluster this morning. posting raw numbers and a short summary.

jia: thanks! can you paste the commands and config you used?

ev an: oops typo. evan: command was: `./tools/run_bench.sh --model sparrow-6b --dtype fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 300`

maria: nice. what hardware?

ev an: ran on g5.12xlarge (A10G equiv) nodes, single-GPU per process, 32GB GPU RAM.

leo: results? p50/p95?

ev an: short version: steady-state throughput ~ 420 tokens/s, p50 latency ~ 7.2s for a 1024 seq, p95 ~ 11.6s. mem peak ~ 17.8GB.

jia: that p95 seems a bit high compared to similar 6B profiles — did kv cache eviction or host swapping happen? any OOM logs?

ev an: no OOMs. saw a couple of small spikes in GPU utilization drops (to ~55%) around iter 120-125; likely GC on the infra side. attached the small log snippet.

maria: can you paste the perfbot link? would like the full timeseries.

ev an: perfbot: summary upload -> https://perf.redwood.local/runs/1810001111/sparrow-6b-light; (perfbot posted detailed flamegraphs + traces).

perfbot: [auto] run 1810001111 processed. metrics: avg_tps=420, p50_lat=7.2s, p95_lat=11.6s, gpu_mem_peak=17.8GB, cpu_sys=12.3%. Artifacts: /artifacts/1810001111/

leo: thanks. can we reproduce with seq=512 and batch=16 to check batching sensitivity?

ev an: good idea — I'll kick that next. ETA ~30m.

(30m later)

ev an: follow-up: seq=512, batch=16 -> steady throughput ~ 480 tokens/s, p50 4.1s, p95 6.9s. batching helps as expected.

jia: ok that aligns. can you also run with `--kv-caching on`? we need to verify prefix caching benefit for our chat workload.

ev an: starting that now on a 2-hour smoke run with realistic prompt mix. will post results into same thread.

maria: if kv-caching shows >15% gain, let's add a recommended config to onboarding docs and create a small autodetect rule in Optimize.

(2h later)

ev an: kv-caching run finished. results: +22% tokens/s vs baseline for seq=1024 (now ~512 tps), p95 down to 9.1s. memory increased by ~600MB. logs: `grep -A2 "kv_cache" /tmp/1810001111/logs | tail -n +1`.

leo: sweet. any regression flags? compare to our 6b target profile?

ev an: comparing to target: p50 within 3% of baseline target, p95 is slightly above target by ~4%. overall pass but file a follow-up to investigate the initial GPU util dips.

jia: created ticket INF-1624 to track the util dips + infra GC hypothesis, assigned to eng-infra.

maria: can you add a one-liner summary for the public onboarding note (what to expect, best config) so I can update the doc?

ev an: sure: "Sparrow-6B (fp16) on g5-class nodes: expect ~420 tps (seq1024, batch8). Enable KV-caching for chat workloads for ~+20% throughput at ~600MB extra GPU memory. For best p95, prefer increased batching (batch16) where latency SLO allows."

leo: perfect. :rocket:

perfbot: [auto] doc-snapshot created: https://docs.redwood.local/onboarding/sparrow-6b/summary-1810001111

maria: thanks everyone. evan, please paste the final artifact links and then mark the thread resolved when you close the ticket.

ev an: added artifacts to the ticket and the doc. marking resolved here. :white_check_mark:
